FILES: rich/cells.py:10
ROOT CAUSE: The regex `_is_single_cell_widths` used to detect strings with only single-width characters is incorrect. It uses the range `\u0020-\u006f`, which only covers characters up to 'o' in lowercase, missing 'p' through 'z' and others.
CHANGE: Update the regex to include the full range of basic Latin characters that are single-width. A common fix is to expand `\u006f` to `\u007f` or use a more comprehensive range. Specifically, for standard ASCII/Latin-1, `\u0020-\u007f` covers most of the basic set.
